verdict.rationale: Crossmint offers webhooks for wallet/payment/user events and an onchain policy engine with spend caps, counterparties, and time windows that auto-enforce agent transactions without per-action prompts, which is rule-based automation of a sort. However there's no documented declarative 'if event X then action Y' rule builder tying webhook events to automatic downstream actions — webhooks are notifications you must handle yourself. Missing for 10: a first-class event-triggered automation/rules engine (not just spend-permission enforcement), documentation of custom trigger conditions beyond payments/wallets, and independent evidence of this working end-to-end.
